mods.note: Static-glow variant of Bloodskal Blade 4 (120399), built here because the mod page ships no such option - only MAIN (pulsing + embers), No Glow, No Guard Engravings and a Sheath. User ruling 2026-08-30: 'The pulse looks bad on Bloodskal Blade, so no to that. Just the simple glow version.' MAIN's animation is three controllers on 40 blocks: [20] BSLightingShaderPropertyColorController drives Emissive Color on the fxglow shader via [24]/[25] NiPosData, cycling (0.694,0.392,0.369) -> (0.808,0.812,0.388) -> back over 4 s; [21] BSLightingShaderPropertyFloatController at freq 8 drives the brightness via [22]/[23] NiFloatData, 0.3 -> 0.8 -> 0; [31] BSEffectShaderPropertyFloatController scrolls the embers' V Offset via [32]/[33] NiFloatData, 0 -> 1. METHOD: rather than delete blocks and renumber every reference, all three key curves were FROZEN IN PLACE to constants with zero tangents - colour pinned to the authored t=0 value, brightness pinned to the authored resting 0.3, ember V-offset pinned to 0. 42 bytes changed, file length identical at 429,837 B, block table/type table/string table byte-identical, so no dangling reference is possible. Verified: header re-read matches on all counts and nif-port-cli inspect reports valid=true, unknownBlocks=false, 5 shapes, all 11 texture paths intact. Result is a constant red emissive glow with no heartbeat and no ember motion. TUNING: brightness lives at file offset 0x510DA (3 keys x 16 B), colour at 0x51122 (3 keys x 40 B). To remove the ember element entirely rather than freeze it, zero the BSEffectShaderProperty emissiveMultiple at 0x5E4F3 (currently 1.0; its emissiveColor is at 0x5E4E3). 'Bloodskal Blade 4 - No Glow' was DISABLED, not removed. Permissions: 'Feel free to use, just give due credits.' Local-only, nothing committed; the vendor mod folder is untouched. NOTE the vendor mesh is Oldrim format (NIF stream 83, NiTriShape) - same class as #77, not addressed here.
